description: Read learned pricing for your workspace: whether the default optimizer prices from the elasticity learned from your own quotes and their outcomes, how new estimates are applied (auto or approve, null until chosen), the mode it runs in now (off, preview, auto or approve), whether owners and admins are emailed, every estimate per product and pooled over the workspace with an example price it gives against the assumed default (also while learning is off, as a preview), progress toward what an estimate needs, and the recent changes. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.
name: get_learned_pricing
